A_original_live_identity.readers_and_use: The original launchers/hooks and later selected-input consumers compare the complete restored original identity and source/config bytes. These files are not globally unused. Restore the full old file at the original logical path before unchanged historical readers.
A_original_live_identity.recovery: All five have exactly the canonical_identity Git blob and size. Copying those complete canonical bytes restores the old file; this byte identity does not merge five run histories or imply equal candidate/final states.
A_original_live_identity.failures_kept: Actual21 failed candidate construction at a combined determinant guard; actual22 isolated finite determinant underflow; actual23 completed a full candidate and one no-J evaluation but failed tolerance; actual25 had a full with-J base and ten guard-failed trials; actual28 was a complete diagnostic capture with planned stop and no nonlinear acceptance.

The kernel verifies the whole ZIP before extraction, records transport and extracted-file metadata, moves its receipt last and seals files read-only; it explicitly does not claim atomic whole-directory publication. B_realized_trial_metadata.original_parameters: Both whole original requests and whole dedicated workflows are copied without removing source pins, alpha, four row definitions, all 224 incoming columns, original direct outgoing terms, exact workers/budgets and original artifact/file SHA tuples.
B_realized_trial_metadata.limits: No large candidate body was fetched. The three whole file SHA256 values remain null. Original ZIP/download hashes are separate known identities.
